a.xlink:title: Implements parsing of servers, locations, and directives.
Declares the ConfigParser for syntactic/semantic directive parsing.
Declares the Config aggregate for parsed virtual servers.
Declares the Server class for virtual host configuration.
Declares the Location class for route-specific configuration.
Declares the Tokenizer for config lexical analysis.
Declares parse/validation error types for the config subsystem.
Declares handler maps for server/location directives.
Token and TokenType declarations for the config lexer.
